units.text: Neodent Dental Hospital provides specialist-led dental care across two Hyderabad locations — in Mehdipatnam and Nampally. Each clinic serves patients seeking restorative, implant, prosthodontic, preventive and smile-focused treatment within the same Neodent clinical environment.
Find your clinic. Mehdipatnam or Nampally.

Neodent's Mehdipatnam clinic in Humayun Nagar is the original Hyderabad location, providing patients access to specialist-led dental care across restorative, prosthodontic, implant and preventive needs — the practice that began here in 1994 and continues today.
10-3-14B/11/1, near Masjid-e-Azizia, Humayun Nagar, Royal Colony, Mehdipatnam, Hyderabad, Telangana 500006
Get directions to Neodent Mehdipatnam (opens in a new tab)
Dr. Md. Miftah Ur Rahman practises here

The Nampally clinic brings the same Neodent clinical approach to central Hyderabad, supporting patients through consultation, treatment planning, treatment and follow-up care within the Medwin Hospital Complex.
Medwin Hospital Complex, Pillar #A1270, Raghav Ratna Towers, Chirag Ali Lane, Mahesh Nagar Colony, Nampally, Hyderabad, Telangana 500001
Get directions to Neodent Nampally (opens in a new tab)
Dr. Md. Miftah Ur Rahman practises here
Different surroundings. The same approach to care.

While the settings differ in character and location, both clinics follow the same patient-focused approach to consultation, treatment planning and follow-up care — the approach that has defined Neodent since 1994, carried forward across both Hyderabad branches.

Across Mehdipatnam and Nampally, Neodent's clinical spaces are shaped around the practical needs of dental care — from consultation and treatment to follow-up. The surroundings differ between the two locations, but both reflect the same focus on clear, comfortable and clinically focused patient care.
Featured dental treatments, at both clinics.
Composite Build-upRebuild part of a damaged tooth with tooth-coloured composite resin.REPAIR
Dental ImplantsReplace a missing tooth with an implant-supported crown, bridge or denture.REPLACE
Root Canal TreatmentTreat infection or inflammation inside a tooth so it may be kept.PRESERVE
Braces & OrthodonticsGradually move teeth into position, then use retainers to help hold them.ALIGN
Smile Design & Cosmetic DentistryPlan cosmetic options around the changes you want to make to your smile.REFINE
Full Mouth RehabilitationPlan staged care when many teeth or the bite need attention.REBUILD
Scaling & PolishingRemove plaque and tartar, then polish the tooth surfaces.MAINTAIN
